title: Digital Strategist
jobDescription: As an Digital Strategist, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful adoption of marketing technology platforms by increasing employee engagement, streamlining operational models, and driving sustainable change. You'll work with Adobe’s largest enterprise customers, guiding them through digital marketing transformation across technology, business processes, organizational structures, and workforce capabilities. This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and hands-on experience with organizational change. You’ll help customers navigate the complexities of onboarding and adopting new digital solutions—ensuring they unlock the full potential of their investments. Strategy & Change Leadership. Lead digital transformation engagements focused on change management, operating model refinement, and organizational design. Partner with executive stakeholders to align digital strategy with business goals. Facilitate discovery sessions and strategic workshops to uncover needs and co-create solutions. Deliver compelling executive-level presentations, strategic roadmaps, and value frameworks. Change Management Execution. Apply structured change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci) to drive adoption. Create actionable deliverables for change levers: communication plans, sponsor roadmaps, training and coaching programs, and resistance management. Assess change readiness, conduct impact analyses, and develop stakeholder engagement plans. Support project teams in integrating change activities into delivery plans. Define and implement future-state operating models, team structures, and process frameworks. Coach senior leaders and managers to act as effective change sponsors. Support the development and delivery of training programs to drive user adoption. Contribute to the evolution of the Digital Strategy & Performance practice. Share knowledge, mentor team members, and support methodology development. Collaborate closely with Adobe’s delivery and partner teams to ensure seamless execution. 10+ years of experience in digital strategy, marketing technology, or business transformation. Strong executive presence and communication skills—verbal, written, and visual. Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or similar platforms (Salesforce, Oracle, etc.). Deep understanding of digital marketing strategy and marketing operations. Background in one or more key industries (e.g., retail, finance, travel, media). Hands-on experience in creating and delivering value-driven business cases. Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and stakeholder management capabilities. Change Management:Prosci Change Management Certification. APMG International Change Management Certification. Project & Portfolio Management:Familiarity with project management tools, phases, and methodologies. Naturally collaborative and comfortable working in cross-functional environments. Resilient, adaptable, and able to work through ambiguity. Organized with a strategic mindset and tactical execution skills. Strong influencing skills and ability to drive consensus among diverse stakeholders. Passion for helping clients achieve measurable business value through transformation. Key Responsibilities. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and Gen Studio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

title: Professional Services Account Executive-Spanish
jobDescription: The Adobe Professional Services Sales rep will help grow the Services business within the assigned territory’s focused set of accounts. This role will interact strategically with the License Field Sales team to identify, cultivate, and close on new business. Account planning & customer relationship management. Drive net new specific services bookings by identifying and closing professional services engagements. Develop and maintain an active pipeline of forecasted deals to meet monthly, quarterly, and annual quota objectives. Handle RFP/RFI’s as and when vital. Accountable for driving the negotiation, contracting, and owning approval processes. Follow up on leads generated by marketing. Quickly develop strong, positive relationships with new customers by understanding their needs and business objectives. Work with customer to develop a mutual plan on how Adobe can help them transform their digital business. Partner closely with Sales support (solution and business architects) to ensure strong/ compelling customer proposals and recommendations. Collaborate closely with Adobe’s delivery team and co-own the development and management of customer relationships within the accounts for successful project execution. Handle customer concerns and issue resolution. 3-10+ years’ prior experience in an enterprise-level software consulting or services sales role; this includes a consistent track record for attaining and exceeding annual quota. Knowledge of enterprise software development lifecycle, from a service selling standpoint, is essential. Digital Marketing has shown experience is helpful, as is knowledge of Saa S and Cloud-based offerings. Knowledge of large, global field organizations required. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish (B2/C1 CEFR certification or equivalent academic qualification) is required. Prior relevant experience supporting customers in the LATAM market is preferred. Ability to rapidly assess Customer environments from a business process, organizational and technological perspective, and optimal communication opportunities for growth. Ability to collaborate with Adobe software sales to build and execute sophisticated account strategies and sales plays. Nurture and develop positive relationships with existing Customers and extend reach within their organizations. Ability to anticipate problems and recommend innovative solutions; achieve customer happiness through the sale of sound consulting projects. Act as a point of escalation for Customers and License Sales on delivery issues and work with Consulting Leadership to find an appropriate resolution. Maintains relationships with clients by providing support, information, and guidance researching and recommending new opportunities in sync with product improvements or by remaining current on industry trends, market activities. Equipped with intelligence to provide high level pre-sales technical assistance that helps customer with an easier decision making. Excellent team building, verbal, and written communication skills as well as reporting and presentation expertise. Bachelor’s degree with an MBA (preferred). Willingness to work customer time zones in North and South America.
